<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-20. -->
## YouTube and YouTube Music

- **Theme ([#68](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/68)):** Fresh installs now use AMOLED black in dark mode. An explicitly saved dark theme still takes precedence.
- **Translations ([#68](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/68)):** **String resources to keep** now filters the saved APK as well as its language selectors. For example, `ru, uk` keeps Russian and Ukrainian, their selected regional translations, and default English. Leaving the full list unchanged keeps all languages.

## YouTube

- **Shorts ([#69](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/69)):** On YouTube 21.39+, **Clear Screen** in the native Shorts menu uses the stock four-corner icon. Your fullscreen player button keeps its selected style.
- **Snack bar ([#65](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/65)):** In **RVX Settings → General → Snack bar**, turn on **Apply border color to playlist bottom bar** and set a nonzero border width. The switch is off by default and independent of corner radius.

Update to **RVX Patches v1.44.0** in Morphe Manager and repatch your app to get these changes.
